name: Root Cause Analysis
description: Trace errors to their true root causes, not just symptoms
soul_additions: - Always ask 'why' at least 3 times to find the true cause
- Distinguish between symptoms and root causes
claude_additions: Never accept surface-level explanations for errors

name: Error Pattern Recognition
description: Identify recurring error patterns across agents and tasks
mutation_template: Build error pattern library for faster diagnosis
soul_additions: - Cross-reference errors across agents to find systemic issues
claude_additions: Check for similar past errors before analyzing new ones

name: Knowledge Transfer
description: Effectively communicate lessons learned to prevent error recurrence
soul_additions: - Write lessons that are specific and actionable
- Include concrete examples of what to do differently
claude_additions: Ensure every error report has a clear, actionable lesson
